importantFindings: Önnereds own current Herr Elit roster is fresher and more useful than the transfer summary: it lists 21 active players and current shirt numbers for 20 of them.
Rasmus Nyman is present in the current roster as #10, confirming the announced transfer from HK Aranäs.
Felix Lilja is now grouped by the club as a wing. Historical official SHF data identifies him as H6, so canonical H6 is used rather than his older Handbollsligan H9 listing.
Milo Knaapinen is grouped by Önnered as a nine-metre player; EHF lists him as V9/Left Back in 2026, so V9 is used.
Andreas Nilsson remains an active M6: Önnered explicitly announced on 25 Jun that he becomes playing sporting director and continues contributing on court.
Patrick Bols, Hugo Forsberg, Mishels Liaba and Pontus Zetterman are absent from the current roster and independently listed as departures.
No shirt number is displayed for Milo Knaapinen on the current club roster, so it remains null.
